content: {"episode_id":"ep-05027","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, which was denied for lack of precertification or prior authorization. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. We request reconsideration of the $731.82 balance based on this supporting clinical documentation."}
